card.name: Endings of volumetric and fugitive
card.fires_on: The final piece of a few specific words split in two, mainly "etric" in volumetric and "itive" in fugitive. It also fires on similar endings such as diminutive and non-breathable.

modes.label: fugitive and similar
modes.description: The ending "itive" after "fug" or "dimin", mostly in history text about fugitive slaves.
